model: ROLEX Day-Date 40 228238 (40 mm yellow gold, fluted yellow gold bezel, green ombre dial with Roman numerals and day / date windows, Cyclops, President bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (hub cap). Follower of the Day-Date 228235 build (same step / prep, own photo): the 2880 x 2880 retailer render (wristcheck.com, front-on, slightly raised camera so the dial, flange, bezel and hub circles have slightly different centres: ring_centre_mm / bezel_centre_mm in the trace) at 36.053 px/mm anchored on the 40 mm case; case and lugs with the mirrored crown flank from the photo silhouette, polished flange + chamfer + 76 real flutes (152 flat facets with the zig-zag in / out outline), domed crystal, Cyclops date lens, drawn cream-gold baton hands, fluted crown and the President bracelet at the photo's joints; dial (green ombre, Roman numerals, indices, day window, print and photographed hands) comes from one native photo map or the projected steel photo.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 460, lug bottom y 2168 px; the crown rows 1186..1405 take the left flank mirrored about the case centre x 1437.7); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: boundary k = 0..151 counter-clockwise from 12 o'clock; long boundaries (even k: 12 and 9 o'clock) reach r 17.15..19.60 mm, short ones 17.37..19.45 mm; flange 15.70..16.78 mm (grey polished band)

lens.note: Cyclops: outline = trace.lens_mm (rim outer edge, barrel shaped, about 7.4 x 5.8 mm), rim chamfer 0.18 mm then a flat top inset 0.55 mm; shows the projected photo of the lens

hands.note: hands = drawn outlines from edge scans (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the gold faces, dark facets and rims stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Day-Date crown (no guards): flutes x 2172..2228, cap to 2257.5, axis 1.0 mm below the pivot

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. A Jubilee: columns outer / semi / centre / semi / outer, 4 boundaries per bounds row, pieces and z_semi per kind.

bracelet.note: President bracelet: three columns, brushed semicircular outer links (sine-arch barrels, joints from the silhouette steps and shading lines) and polished centre links separated by the measured seams / dark gaps. Rows (px, 36.053 px/mm, pivot (1438, 1260)): outer top 361 / 265 / 187, end 170; outer bottom 2310 / 2468 / 2604 / 2699, end 2715; centre top seams 408 / 315 / 219, bottom dark gaps 2236..2249, 2285.5..2302, 2387..2400, 2436..2451, 2554..2569, end 2714; column lines x 1266.5 / 1589.5 (top), 1265.5 / 1599 (bottom). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
